# GitHub Repository Topics

Set these topics in your repo settings to improve discoverability:

## How to Set Topics
1. Go to https://github.com/M-2000-0/ZPX/settings
2. Under "About" → "Topics", add each tag below (press Enter after each)

## Recommended Topics

| Topic | Why |
|-------|-----|
| `zpx-language` | Primary project identifier |
| `programming-language` | Broad category for language enthusiasts |
| `ai-native` | Core differentiator — designed for AI/LLM code gen |
| `token-efficient` | Key technical advantage (30-60% fewer tokens) |
| `self-hosting` | Major credibility signal — interpreter written in itself |
| `fullstack` | One language for backend, frontend, DB, config |
| `zero-boilerplate` | No imports, no build step, no package.json |
| `python-alternative` | Captures Python devs looking for something new |
| `llm-optimized` | Targets the AI/ML engineer audience |
| `pattern-matching` | Language feature searchers look for this |
| `design-by-contract` | Niche but highly specific keyword |
| `interpreted-language` | Correct technical classification |
| `no-build-step` | Differentiator from TypeScript/Rust/Go |
